question.description: The question, in plain language. Name components as they appear in code (e.g. Button, AlertDialog) when you know them.

component.description: Component id or export name when you already know which one you mean, e.g. ui:button or Button.

domain.description: Force a specialist when you know which kind of question this is; otherwise Docent routes it.

code.description: Proposed code (JSX/TSX) to check against the design system's governance rules before shipping it.

caller.description: Who is asking, for the audit trail, e.g. cursor or checkout-agent.
